intent: Implement the exact six-file dharmagraph SADHANA pre-effect and provider-identity fence. AgentPool exposes bounded ownership-CAS reserve/release methods without leaking private locks. Orchestrator resolves campaign authority to exactly one idle authenticated principal, never substitutes another agent, waits for its scheduled background owner to reach the final campaign-session fence immediately before provider invocation, and bypasses generic same-generation retry for typed campaign work. AgentRunner derives every campaign routing coordinate exclusively from the validated nested provider/model lock, rejects every task/config widening alias before both direct and ModelRouter effects, and validates returned provider/model identity plus the fallback-free route decision. ModelRouter consumes a closed restriction-only carrier to make exactly one request-scoped provider attempt without shared-state mutation, and Ollama maps one exact logical :cloud identity to one exact wire model with no frontier fallback. Generic routing, retry, fallback, and lifecycle behavior remain unchanged when campaign authority is absent. The same packet also removes the three pre-existing Ruff blockers in its owned AgentRunner file without broader cleanup.

gates.name: pre-effect-fence-ruff
gates.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check dharma_swarm/agent_runner.py dharma_swarm/orchestrator.py dharma_swarm/providers.py tests/test_agent_runner.py tests/test_orchestrator.py tests/test_providers.py

negative_controls.name: pause-race-substitution-and-generic-bypass-negatives
negative_controls.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_agent_runner.py tests/test_orchestrator.py tests/test_providers.py -k 'campaign_route_lock or campaign_dispatch_does_not_release_before_provider_fence or campaign_idle_snapshot_race_never_starts_owner_provider or campaign_authority_missing_or_busy_principal_never_falls_back or route_next_never_bypasses_campaign_authority or generic_dispatch_routing_is_unchanged_without_campaign_authority or campaign_actual_router or campaign_routing_alias or campaign_direct_response_identity or campaign_routed_result_identity or campaign_exact_provider_failure or campaign_provider_call or campaign_ollama'

dharmagraph_provides: exact principal selection without campaign fallback
validated nested route-lock consumption before direct or routed provider effect
one exact eligible provider/model lane with all mergeable routing aliases excluded
request-scoped single provider attempt and exact-model provider entry point without shared-state mutation
served response and fallback-free route-decision identity validation
final provider-boundary callback and readiness handshake
organism_provides: typed authority/lease/attempt identity and failure recovery
v5 task/principal/provider/model route-lock construction and lineage validation
sole-writer control-gate serialization around dispatch and operator transition
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: a queued owner can reach only its exact route-locked provider/model and cannot begin that provider after pause because dispatch retains campaign control serialization until the background task validates the final session fence

interface_mismatches: The existing scheduler returns after create_task, not after provider-effect readiness, leaving a deliberate asyncio yield window where pause can overtake the owner.

Generic topology preference can fall back to another idle agent; typed campaign authority requires exact ID equality and no dispatch when the principal is missing, busy, duplicated, or races idle-to-busy.
Reservation recovery must release only the exact opaque owner token this dispatch acquired and must never release a foreign task or another attempt generation.
A campaign pre-provider failure is organism-owned typed recovery and must not enter generic Orchestrator provider retry/requeue.

Campaign top-level and AgentConfig routing metadata are not authority for typed work; any widening alias must be rejected before provider selection, while the nested v5 route-lock alone names the eligible lane.

ModelRouter retries and provider-internal model fallback can create multiple effects behind one apparent call; typed campaign execution requires one request-scoped attempt and one attested served wire model.
honest_blockers: The final callback is a trusted-process fence for the sole production supervisor, not an opaque authority membrane against hostile in-process code.
Once the provider boundary is crossed, pause/stop does not cancel or revoke that already-started call; cancellation remains a separate invoker boundary.
AgentPool CAS and effect readiness prove only local control ordering, not provider liveness, useful output, independent acceptance, promotion, merge, deployment, or publication.
Write-capable task confinement is not implemented here; campaign production dispatch remains read-only/inference-only unless a separately enforced sandbox is injected.

Exact-model execution is fail-closed per provider implementation. The admitted SADHANA roster is Ollama-only; any future provider must add and prove its own non-multiplexing exact-model implementation before campaign use.
The exact-model provider carrier is restriction-only; it cannot create campaign authority, attest model usefulness, or authorize a second effect.
session_entry.rollback: Stop the campaign supervisor and revert this six-file implementation. Generic non-campaign routing returns to its prior behavior; campaign dispatch must remain disabled because exact principal reservation, queued-before-pause protection, and exact single-model provider execution would no longer hold. Preserve all existing tasks, runs, claims, receipts, and leases; no external cancellation or cleanup is authorized.
